items.title: Parley: Federated, decentralised chat that speaks plain IRC
items.summary: Parley is a new federated and decentralized chat application that utilizes plain IRC protocols, aiming to provide a more open communication platform. Developers should care as it promotes user privacy and control over their communication channels.

items.title: AI companies in race to demonstrate their model most threatening to humanity
items.summary: A report highlights the competitive landscape among AI companies striving to showcase their models as the most advanced, raising ethical concerns about their potential threats to humanity. This development is crucial for engineers and developers to consider the implications of their work in AI safety and ethics.

items.title: SpaceX's Starship launching to orbit for first time ever today
items.summary: SpaceX's Starship is set to launch to orbit for the first time, marking a significant milestone in aerospace engineering and space exploration. This event is pivotal for engineers in the field, showcasing advancements in rocket technology and the future of interplanetary travel.

items.title: Prompting Claude Opus 5.5
items.summary: The latest update on Claude Opus 5.5 introduces new prompting techniques that enhance the model's performance and usability. Developers should explore these advancements to improve their applications and leverage AI capabilities more effectively.

items.title: Don't couple your Go code to GitHub
items.summary: A new article discusses the pitfalls of tightly coupling Go code to GitHub, advocating for more modular and flexible coding practices. This insight is essential for developers looking to enhance the maintainability and portability of their projects.
